_doc: Player arsenal (src/core/arsenal.gd). melee: dmg/speed(time x)/reach(+m)/push/shield(+pips)/stun(s)/arc(min facing dot: lower = wider)/pierce(armor)/finisher. ranged: dmg/rate(shots per s x)/speed/pellets/spread(deg)/life(s)/push/special(chain|pull|grenade)/range/chains/stun/radius/charge. Unlock by picking up the item 'weapon_<id>' (shops, drops, starting kit by background).

baton.name: Shock Baton
baton.desc: Fast, stuns on every hit, cracks shields.

chain.name: Chain Whip
chain.desc: Long reach, hits everything in a wide arc.

katana.name: Mono-Katana
katana.desc: Cuts through armour and riot shields.

hammer.name: Repo Hammer
hammer.desc: Slow. Enormous. The last hit sends out a shockwave.

sidearm.name: Sidearm
sidearm.desc: Accurate. Hold to charge a piercing shot.

scatter.name: Scatter Cannon
scatter.desc: Six pellets, huge knockback. Get close.

arc.name: Arc Thrower
arc.desc: Instant lightning that jumps to two more enemies and stuns.

harpoon.name: Repo Harpoon
harpoon.desc: Drags the target to you. Rips riot shields aside.

grenade.name: Paste Grenade
grenade.desc: Lobbed. Explodes in a 3 m splash. Never hits civilians.

start_kit._doc: background -> extra weapon at the start of a life
